Onboard AI handles cloud filtering, spectral band alignment, and compression so that downlinked products feed directly into Kuva Sense, where automated analytics generate insights-as-a-service for agriculture (crop identification, yield forecasting, harvest timing), aquaculture (water quality, algal bloom detection, biomass), environment and carbon (sequestration monitoring, deforestation, pollution tracking), and safety and security (vessel detection and tracking, illegal activity warning, rapid change detection). Kuva Space is part of the European Space Agency InCubed-co-funded HYPERFIELD program, was awarded a €1.8M ESA Civil Security from Space contract within the SMART-CONNECT consortium to demonstrate rapid hyperspectral insights for crisis response, and in 2026 signed a Letter of Intent with SSC Space to strengthen Nordic space capabilities. The commercial model is subscription-based insights-as-a-service rather than pay-per-pixel imagery sales, with current access offered through the Kuva Sense Early Adopter Program; the company markets "robust APIs and customizable data formats" for system integration but does not currently publish open public API reference documentation, an OpenAPI specification, or a self-service developer portal. The only public engineering surface is the open-source kuva-data-processing Python toolkit (kuva-metadata, kuva-reader, kuva-geometry) on GitHub and PyPI, which reads Kuva GeoTIFF-based L0/L1AB/L1C/L2A data products and their metadata sidecars.

providers.name: Plant Cartridge
providers.description: Plant Cartridge is a Malaysian ag-tech company modernizing sustainable agriculture with modular growing systems for indoor and vertical farming. It designs and builds growing environments, supplies growing systems, and offers managed services to cultivate leafy vegetables, herbs, and fruiting vegetables with a faster growth rate while saving water, nutrients, and growing media. Headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Selangor with operations at Technology Park Malaysia in Kuala Lumpur, the company empowers farmers in the ag-tech transformation to help secure the food future. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global, Plant Cartridge publishes a marketing and news website but no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: FarMart
providers.description: FarMart is an AI-powered food sourcing and procurement platform that connects suppliers, food manufacturers, processors, and logistics providers across the global food and energy supply chain. It provides end-to-end procurement infrastructure including verified supplier discovery, five-minute AI-powered KYC verification, compliance management, market-to-factory batch traceability, automated invoicing and e-way bill generation, and real-time payment settlement in one to four hours. FarMart serves food companies, HoReCa (hospitality) buyers, and bio-fuel supply chains, with a network spanning 100+ premium buyers, 50+ food categories, and 10,000+ suppliers.

providers.name: FMC Corporation
providers.description: FMC Corporation is a Philadelphia-headquartered global agricultural sciences company that develops and supplies crop protection products including herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, and biological solutions, alongside precision agriculture technology. Originally founded as the Food Machinery Corporation, the modern FMC focuses on productivity and resilience for growers worldwide. This repository tracks the FMC Corporation entity and any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts. No public APIs or developer programs are currently published. Note that "FMC" is also commonly used as an abbreviation for the legacy FMC Technologies brand (now TechnipFMC), which is tracked separately under the fmc-technologies repository.

providers.name: Fox-Tech
providers.description: FOX-TECH CO. is a New Taipei City, Taiwan IoT company (founded 2016, backed by 500 Global and SparkLabs Taipei) that digitally transforms farming, logistics, cold-chain, and manufacturing operations. Its TempHawk platform pairs wireless temperature, humidity, CO2, light-intensity and soil-EC sensors over Sigfox LPWAN with web and mobile apps and cloud data analytics, helping the perishable-goods value chain monitor conditions, manage risk, and meet policy compliance. Recognized on the Forward Fooding FoodTech 500. No public API, developer portal, or SDK is currently published.

providers.name: Fyto
providers.description: Fyto is a Bay Area agricultural cleantech and robotics company, founded in 2019 by Jason Prapas with MIT origins, that builds automated cultivation systems for lemna — fast-growing aquatic "superplants" in the duckweed family. Its ReCover process, GrowGrid raised growbeds, and autonomous Harvester machine capture excess nutrients from dairy and livestock operations and convert them into high-protein animal feed, cutting nitrate pollution and greenhouse-gas emissions without arable land, synthetic fertilizer, or manual labor. Backed by GV, Fyto is scaling regenerative farming from California's San Joaquin Valley. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation is currently published.

providers.name: GigaCrop
providers.description: GigaCrop is an agricultural biotechnology company engineering the photosynthesis pathway to dramatically increase crop productivity. Founded by Chris Eiben, PhD, the company combines enzyme engineering and machine learning to optimize the RuBisCo enzyme, aiming to roughly double yields in staple crops such as corn and soy and to break past the limits that have held annual yield gains near one percent for a century. Backed by Playground Global, GigaCrop is working to make agriculture both more sustainable and more abundant.

providers.name: Lithos Carbon
providers.description: Lithos Carbon delivers permanent carbon dioxide removal through enhanced rock weathering on agricultural land. The company applies crushed basalt to farm fields, where it captures atmospheric CO2 while raising soil pH, replenishing nutrients (iron, magnesium, phosphorus, calcium), improving crop yields, and building resilience to drought and pests. Lithos uses machine-learning soil models to optimize basalt application rates and provides measurement, reporting, and verification of the resulting carbon removal, managing delivery, sampling, and installation end to end for farmers and carbon-credit buyers. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures and Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: Ninjacart
providers.description: Ninjacart is India's largest agritech B2B fresh-produce supply-chain company, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Bengaluru. It connects farmers and producers directly with retailers, kirana stores, and businesses, removing layers of middlemen from the fruit-and-vegetable supply chain. Its product portfolio spans Ninja Mandi (wholesale produce marketplace), Ninja Kisan (farmer sourcing), Ninja Kirana (retailer supply), and Ninja Global, alongside a technology-licensing model, Ninja Tech Ventures, and a Startup Program that gives FoodTech/AgTech startups access to its supply-chain tooling (demand forecasting, pricing intelligence, procurement, inventory, logistics, and catalog management). Ninjacart is backed by investors including Accel, Tiger Global, and Walmart/Flipkart. As of this profile it exposes no public self-serve developer API or documentation; technology access is handled through partnerships (partnerships@ninjacart.com).

providers.name: Nitricity
providers.description: Nitricity is a climate-tech and agricultural-technology company that produces nitrogen fertilizer on-farm from only air, water, and renewable electricity. Founded in 2018 by Stanford graduate researchers Nicolas Pinkowski and Joshua McEnaney, the company uses a solar-powered plasma / electrochemical process to fix atmospheric nitrogen and produce nitric acid and calcium nitrate fertilizers on-site and on-demand, eliminating the fossil-fuel-intensive Haber-Bosch process and long-distance transportation that make conventional fertilizer responsible for roughly 5% of global greenhouse gas emissions. Backed by Khosla Ventures, Fine Structure Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital, and strategic investor Chipotle, Nitricity is a hardware and physical-product company; it publishes a corporate website, blog, and field-trial program but exposes no public API, developer portal, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Plantd
providers.description: Plantd is an American advanced-materials manufacturer based in Oxford, North Carolina, founded in 2021 by former SpaceX engineers Nathan Silvernail (CEO) and Huade Tan (CTO) with Josh Dorfman (CMO). The company grows and harvests fast-growing perennial grass on farms across North Carolina and Virginia and presses it into carbon-negative structural building panels intended to replace oriented strand board (OSB), plywood and other timber-based sheathing. Production runs on a modular, all-electric, closed-loop manufacturing platform in a 150,000+ sq ft facility, with a research farm in Stovall, NC. Customers and partners include homebuilder D.R. Horton and furniture brand Studio TK. Plantd has raised roughly $47.5M across seed, Series A and a $22M Series B (October 2025). Plantd is a physical-goods manufacturer: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind — this profile records that absence rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Thrive Agritech
providers.description: Thrive Agritech is a horticultural lighting company that designs and manufactures high-efficiency LED grow lights and related power systems for commercial indoor farming, greenhouses, and vertical farming operations. Its product line includes fixtures such as Strata, Boost XE, and a 1050W LED grow light, along with a Remote Power System, backed by lighting design services, rebate assistance, and multi-year warranties. The company positions itself around energy efficiency, ROI, and long-term grower partnerships rather than a developer or API offering. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, this profile was enriched by probing the public web surface; no public API, developer portal, documentation, or machine-readable specification was found.

providers.name: Climavision
providers.description: Climavision is a Louisville, Kentucky weather intelligence company that combines a proprietary nationwide supplemental network of low-altitude X-band, dual-polarization gap-filling weather radars with AI-driven numerical weather prediction (NWP) to deliver enterprise-grade forecasts and observational data. Its Horizon AI product line includes Horizon Point for site-specific forecasts, Horizon Global for ground-to-high- altitude global models, Horizon HI-RES for custom high-resolution local forecasting, and Horizon S2S for subseasonal-to-seasonal prediction. Climavision exposes a Weather API hosted at point-forecast-api.climavision.com with 1,800+ parameters, 15-day forecasts, and bearer-token authentication, plus a separate Radar Status API and Radar-as-a-Service offering that supplies Level II files, NetCDF, and GeoTIFF radar data products (reflectivity, velocity, dual-pol-derived QPE at 1km, precipitation type, tornado debris detection) for coverage below 4,000 feet where NEXRAD cannot see due to Earth curvature. The company integrates its radar feed into MRMS and has provided supplemental data into the National Weather Service's AWIPS software. Climavision processes 1.5+ billion datasets daily, serves customers across agriculture, aviation, commodity trading, drones and Advanced Air Mobility, energy and utilities, government, insurance and reinsurance, media, and transportation and logistics, and raised a $100 million strategic investment from TPG's Rise Fund. API access is gated through a sales-led contact process; no public sandbox or open-source SDKs are published, and the Climavision GitHub organization (github.com/Climavision) currently has only two minor public repositories (an archived Azure Table Storage helper and a GeoServer Helm chart fork).

providers.name: Boson Motors
providers.description: Boson Motors is an electric vehicle and robotics company founded in 2017, building a modular electric off-road utility vehicle (UTV) platform for agriculture, farm automation, and work applications. Its flagship LX40 is a user-serviceable, low-maintenance electric 4WD UTV that charges from a standard 110v outlet and accepts interchangeable work modules for spraying, hauling, and crew transport. The company operates engineering and production out of Tada, Andhra Pradesh, India, with a strategic base in Fremont, California, and maintains a robotics arm (Boson Robotics) focused on autonomous and agricultural automation. Boson Motors is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes a consumer marketing and reservation site with no public developer program, API, SDK, or developer documentation; its public engineering footprint is a GitHub organization of ROS/robotics libraries. This profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network lead and enrichment target.

providers.name: Bowery
providers.description: Bowery Farming was an American indoor vertical-farming (controlled-environment agriculture) company headquartered in New York City that grew leafy greens and herbs in automated, pesticide-free indoor farms serving major East Coast metro areas. Once valued at roughly $2.3 billion and backed by investors including Bloomberg Beta and SV Angel, the company ceased operations in November 2024 and its facilities and equipment entered liquidation through 2025-2026. Bowery published no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or discovery surface; this API Evangelist profile records the company's identity and its probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Corteva
providers.description: Corteva Agriscience is a publicly traded, Fortune 500 global pure-play agriculture company that provides farmers around the world with one of the most complete portfolios in the industry, including a balanced and diverse mix of seed, crop protection, and digital products. Corteva was formed as the spinoff of the agriculture division of DowDuPont in June 2019. The company markets seeds under the Pioneer, Brevant, and other brands and crop protection products including herbicides, fungicides, insecticides, and biologicals. Corteva also operates Granular, a farm management software platform with insights and analytics products. A public developer API is not currently published; growers access tools through the Granular Insights and Granular Link platforms.

providers.name: Monsanto
providers.description: Monsanto was a global agricultural products company that produced seeds, biotechnology trait products, and herbicides before being acquired by Bayer AG in 2018. Operations and brands have since been integrated into the Bayer Crop Science division.

providers.name: 10 Percent
providers.description: 10 Percent is a two-sided agricultural marketplace with embedded financial services, a Speedinvest portfolio company (invested ~2020) operating in the agri-fintech and marketplaces space. Public sources describe it combining agricultural supply-chain e-commerce, grain procurement, and business-intelligence services with embedded financing such as factoring and credit offered inside transactions to help agricultural partners manage cash flow and access capital. It was surfaced as a Speedinvest portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment searched the public web and found no developer portal, documentation, or public API surface, so no API artifacts could be harvested. This profile remains an identity-only lead pending a discoverable API.

providers.name: AgLocal
providers.description: AgLocal was a venture-backed food-technology startup (founded 2011 by Mike Hsieh and Naithan Jones, Kansas City / San Francisco) that built an online marketplace connecting small family ranchers and sustainable meat producers directly with buyers. It launched in 2013 as a ranch-to-restaurant marketplace serving chefs, then pivoted in 2014 to a consumer-facing monthly meat subscription service. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Chicago Ventures and others across roughly $3.8M in funding, the company shut down in 2015, stating it could not reach a self-sustaining business model. It is added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio lead; the company is now defunct and its domain (aglocal.com) is parked/for sale, so no live developer portal, API, or specifications exist to enrich.

providers.name: AgroSpheres
providers.description: AgroSpheres is an agricultural biotechnology company based in Charlottesville, Virginia, founded by University of Virginia researchers, that develops bio-based crop protection products built on its AgriCell bioparticle platform. The company uses a single-step fermentation process that produces and biodegradably encapsulates biological actives all at once, giving added stability and a tunable release profile for targeted, non-toxic pest and disease control intended to be safe for pollinators, people and soil. Its first commercial product, the broad-spectrum biofungicide FUN-THYME, is marketed through an exclusive partnership with Wilbur-Ellis and was approved in California in 2026. AgroSpheres manufactures at a biomanufacturing facility in Charlottesville. It is a physical agricultural-inputs business and publishes no developer program, public API, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Bear Flag Robotics
providers.description: Bear Flag Robotics is an autonomous-tractor company that retrofits existing farm tractors with sensors, onboard compute, and path-planning software to enable driverless field operations such as tillage and row-crop work. Founded in 2017 and backed by Y Combinator and True Ventures, the company was acquired by John Deere in August 2021 and now advances Deere's autonomy roadmap. It is a hardware and agricultural-robotics business with no public developer API, SDK, documentation portal, or GitHub surface; its website redirects to John Deere.

providers.name: Ch4 Global
providers.description: CH4 Global is a climate-technology company working to reduce methane emissions from livestock at gigatonne scale. Its flagship product, Methane Tamer, is a feed supplement made from Asparagopsis red seaweed that has been shown to cut enteric methane emissions in cattle by up to 90 percent. In January 2025 the company began production at what it describes as the world's first commercial-scale Asparagopsis growing facility, its EcoPark in Louth Bay, South Australia, using a proprietary pond-based cultivation system to lower production costs. CH4 Global is a deep-tech and agriculture-focused company backed by DCVC; it operates as a physical-product and climate-impact business rather than a software or API provider. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead and enriched with the identity and domain-security signals that are publicly available.

providers.name: Chickin
providers.description: Chickin is an Indonesian poultry-technology company operating a full-stack, integrated ecosystem for chicken farmers across Indonesia. It combines closed-house smart-farming hardware (IoT climate and environmental controllers), day-old-chick and feed supply, farmer financing, and guaranteed offtake and distribution of live birds, aiming to modernize and de-risk small and mid-scale poultry farming. Backed by 500 Global, Chickin runs its operations through a mobile and web application at chickin.id. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile records its public web presence and domain-security posture and remains a lead for further enrichment should a developer surface be published.

providers.name: Cultivaet Technologies Holding Ltd.
providers.description: Cultivaet Technologies Holding Ltd. is an AI-driven agricultural technology ("AgriTech for Humanity") startup based in Egypt serving smallholder farmers across the Middle East. Its products include a Farmer AI Companion delivering personalized weather, crop-planning, pest-control and soil-health insights, a Knowledge Platform that collects/analyzes/distributes social and scientific agricultural data, and a Business SaaS connecting farmers with food-industry buyers for sustainable procurement and traceability. The company is backed by 500 Global and Sanabil and is part of the Google Cloud Startups Program (pre-seed, 2024). As of this enrichment pass Cultivaet publishes only a marketing site (cultivaet.ai) with no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or other developer surface, so no API artifacts were generated.

providers.name: Farmeron
providers.description: Farmeron was a dairy herd-management and farm-analytics SaaS founded in 2011 in Osijek, Croatia, that helped dairy producers track animals, feed, milk production, and farm operations through a web platform and data integrations. The company went through the 500 Startups accelerator and was acquired by the machine-vision agriculture firm Cainthus in 2016, after which the standalone Farmeron product was wound down. This network profile is retained as a historical/portfolio lead; the farmeron.com domain is registered but no longer serves a live website or API, so there is no public developer surface to enrich.

providers.name: GAGO Group
providers.description: GAGO Group (Beijing Jiage Tianyu Technology Co., Ltd.) is a China-based frontier-technology company focused on agricultural and rural big data applications. Its homepage positions the business around agricultural and rural big data, applying remote-sensing and data-analytics techniques to agriculture. GAGO Group is backed by DCM Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network from that portfolio. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a corporate website at gagogroup.cn but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification could be verified, so no spec-derived API artifacts were produced.

providers.name: infarm
providers.description: infarm (Indoor Urban Farming GmbH) is a Berlin-based vertical/indoor farming company, surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. The company builds modular, cloud-connected growing systems for herbs, leafy greens, and produce placed in grocery stores and distribution hubs. This profile was enriched by the pipeline; infarm publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface, and its website is bot-blocked (HTTP 403) to automated access, so only domain-level security posture could be probed. It remains a company/identity record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Katch
providers.description: Katch is a Speedinvest-backed agricultural technology and embedded-finance platform serving agribusiness supply chains. It offers essential digital services for its partners, including e-commerce, grain procurement, and business intelligence, and layers embedded financial solutions such as factoring and credit directly within transactions. This lets agricultural partners manage cash flow, access working capital, and streamline supply-chain operations from a single platform. Katch was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; an enrichment pass found no public developer program, API documentation, OpenAPI, or machine-readable API surface for the company at this time.

providers.name: Kubota Corporation
providers.description: Kubota Corporation is a Japanese multinational manufacturing agricultural, construction, and industrial machinery, including compact tractors, excavators, mowers, utility vehicles, engines, and water and environmental infrastructure systems sold in over 120 countries. Kubota does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; equipment telematics (KubotaNOW) and dealer integrations are handled through partner channels rather than open APIs.

providers.name: Land O'Lakes
providers.description: Land O'Lakes is a member-owned agricultural cooperative providing food, agriculture, and animal nutrition products to farmers, retailers, and consumers, with brands including Land O'Lakes butter and Purina Animal Nutrition.

providers.name: microTERRA
providers.description: microTERRA is a Mexico-based food-ingredient company that develops functional ingredients derived from Lemna (duckweed). Its MAS product line delivers natural flavor enhancers and texture modifiers for the food and beverage industry, positioned as sustainable, clean-label alternatives that support salt and sugar reduction in formulations. A Techstars-backed B2B startup, microTERRA sells to food formulators and manufacturers and does not currently expose any public developer API, SDK, CLI, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Milk Moovement
providers.description: Milk Moovement is a dairy supply chain software company that provides cloud-based logistics, scheduling, routing, quality tracking, and automated payroll tools for dairy cooperatives and processors across North America. The platform digitizes the movement of milk from farm to processor, giving producers, haulers, and cooperatives real-time visibility into the dairy supply chain. The company was surfaced via the techstars portfolio and enriched into the API Evangelist network; as of this pass it publishes no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, or status page.

providers.name: Molagri
providers.description: Molagri is a Toronto-based biotechnology startup building next-generation biopesticides for agriculture. The company designs pest-control molecules that target specific molecular pathways unique to pest insects while preserving pollinators and other beneficial organisms, and uses predictive modeling to stay ahead of the evolution of pest resistance. Molagri emphasizes higher efficacy and biobased production to reduce emissions across both manufacturing and field application. Founded in 2026 by University of Toronto PhD biochemists Zaky Hassan and Min Jin, the company was part of the Y Combinator Summer 2026 batch. It was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for tracking; as an early-stage biotech it currently publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Omeat
providers.description: Omeat (rebranded as Evergreen Select) is a cultivated-beef company that partners with global meat producers to create price-predictable, industrial-scale beef supply. It produces 100% real beef without antibiotics, hormones, or plant-based fillers, positioning cultivated meat as a practical supplement to conventional supply chains while holding pricing at parity with commodity ground beef. Founded by tissue-engineering researcher Ali Khademhosseini and backed by GV, the company targets restaurants and meat processors seeking supply-chain stability and consistent quality. As of this enrichment pass Omeat operates as a food/biotech producer with a marketing website only: no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or GitHub organization were found, so there is no machine-readable API surface to catalog. This profile is retained as a company/lead record surfaced from the GV venture portfolio.

providers.name: OnFarm
providers.description: OnFarm Systems, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Fresno, California, was an agriculture IoT data-integration company that offered a customizable dashboard aggregating in-field sensor and remotely gathered data (weather, soil, irrigation) into a single view for farming operations across the US, Europe, and Asia. OnFarm was acquired by SWIIM System in July 2018, at which point CEO Lance Donny became SWIIM's COO. The onfarm.com domain is now parked and listed for sale, and no live public API, developer documentation, or SDK surface remains. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead; enrichment found no active API surface to harvest.

providers.name: Orbicle Bio
providers.description: Orbicle Bio is an agricultural biotechnology startup developing carbon-negative, microbial-based organic fertilizers derived from soil microbes to replace synthetic fertilizers. Backed by 500 Global, the company targets rice-farming productivity and soil sustainability across Southeast Asian markets such as Vietnam and Thailand, with a commercial product launch planned for 2026. Orbicle Bio publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile is maintained for API Evangelist network completeness and enrichment.

providers.name: Osyva
providers.description: Osyva is a B2B commerce and procurement platform for the veterinary supply sector in Colombia and Latin America ("Gestiona tus compras veterinarias"), connecting veterinary clinics, distributors, and buyers to manage the ordering and purchasing of veterinary products and pharmaceuticals. Backed by 500 Global, Osyva runs a web and mobile application (osyva.com, osyva2go.com) and the related Hubu brand (hubu.com.co). Its platform is powered by internal API hosts (api.osyva.com, api.osyva2go.com), but as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, documentation, or API specification, so its API surface is private.

providers.name: Plantner Inc.
providers.description: Plantner Inc. (PLANTNER) is a South Korean biotechnology company specializing in the extraction and manufacturing of alginic acid, a biodegradable marine-derived biomaterial. Operating as a bio-industry platform provider, Plantner supplies alginic acid-based solutions across medical devices (wound dressings, nutraceuticals), pharmaceuticals (gastroprotective agents, drug-delivery systems), cosmetics (modeling masks, hydrogels), advanced biotech (bio-ink, organoids, delivery carriers), and agriculture (controlled-release fertilizers, mulching films, eco-friendly herbicides). Headquartered in Seoul with an R&D center in Suwon, the company is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is a materials/biotech manufacturer and does not currently publish a developer API, documentation, or developer portal; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Plenty
providers.description: Plenty is an American indoor vertical farming company that grows produce such as leafy greens and strawberries in controlled, climate-independent indoor facilities using proprietary vertical growing systems, automation, and robotics. Headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area and founded in 2014, Plenty is backed by investors including SoftBank Vision Fund and DCM Ventures. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a frontier-tech portfolio-company profile; the public enrichment pass found no public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Prospera
providers.description: Prospera Technologies was an Israeli agricultural-technology company, founded in 2014 and headquartered in Tel Aviv with US offices in Austin, TX, that applied machine learning and computer vision to continuously monitor plant development, health and stress from crop-field imagery and deliver irrigation and crop-growth recommendations to growers through mobile and web dashboards. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Cisco and Qualcomm, Prospera was acquired by Valmont Industries for roughly $300M in 2021 and its technology was folded into Valmont's Valley Insights and the Valley 365 connected crop-management platform. Prospera no longer operates an independent public developer surface: the prospera.ag domain still resolves in DNS but its HTTPS endpoint is unreachable, and no public API, developer portal, or API documentation was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Sabanto
providers.description: Sabanto is an agricultural autonomy company known for retrofitting existing farm tractors and equipment with an autonomy kit and an autonomy-as-a-service model, enabling unmanned tillage, planting, and field operations. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of the enrichment pass on 2026-07-21 the company's primary domain (sabanto.com) no longer resolves to a live site — it redirects to a GoDaddy parked/for-sale page — so no developer portal, API, documentation, SDK, GitHub organization, or other public API surface could be found. This profile is retained as a lead with no live API surface at this time.

providers.name: Samunnati
providers.description: Samunnati is an integrated agri-enterprise platform working to de-fragment India's agricultural value chain by connecting farmers, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), and agri enterprises. It combines financial solutions (lending to farmers, FPOs, and agri businesses), trade facilitation and market linkages, and digital marketplaces (FPO Next, Trade Next, and input, output, credit, and consumer marketplaces), alongside innovation, research, and foundation-led community work. Operating across Chennai, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Jaipur, Odisha, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar, it positions itself as one of India's largest agri enterprises. Samunnati runs several customer-facing digital platforms but does not publish a public developer portal or API at this time.

providers.name: Strella Biotechnology
providers.description: Strella Biotechnology is a Seattle-based produce-quality intelligence company that uses ethylene gas sensors and predictive analytics to reduce food waste across the fresh-produce supply chain. Its product line spans Storage (predicting produce maturity in cold storage), Ripen (automating the ripening process), Sequence (optimizing shipment order to cut shrink), and Monitor (real-time environmental monitoring in logistics). The company reports tracking over two billion pounds of produce across 26 countries and is backed by GV (Google Ventures). As of this enrichment pass, Strella exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhook surface.

providers.name: TopXGun
providers.description: TopXGun (Nanjing TopXGun Robotics / 拓攻机器人) is a Chinese unmanned aerial vehicle manufacturer specializing in the research, development, and production of agricultural spray drones, heavy-lift delivery drones, industrial and cleaning drones, firefighting and emergency UAVs, tethered drones, eVTOL and large unmanned aircraft, and the professional flight-control and avionics hardware, payload equipment, and software systems that power them. Its whole-aircraft capability spans all airspace below 5,000 meters and payloads up to 1.5 tons across core industries, and it offers ODM/OEM customization and education support. Its overseas agricultural line is marketed as TopXGun Agriculture (topxgunag.com) with CE, FCC, RoHS, and KC certifications. Surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures. No public web API, SDK, or developer portal was found during enrichment; this is a hardware manufacturer.

providers.name: Tractor Supply
providers.description: Tractor Supply Company is the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the United States, providing products to support recreational farming, ranching, and country lifestyles. Tractor Supply integrates with suppliers and vendors via EDI and vendor portal systems, enabling order management, invoice processing, and shipment notifications. The company operates through its vendor transaction portal for supplier collaboration and EDI-based supply chain integrations.

providers.name: Tule Technologies
providers.description: Tule Technologies was an agricultural technology company that measured crop water stress and actual evapotranspiration (ET) directly in the field, giving growers irrigation guidance through its FieldStat monitoring tool for orchards, vineyards, and row crops. Backed by Bloomberg Beta, Tule has been acquired by and integrated into CropX; the tuletechnologies.com domain now 301-redirects to cropx.com, where Tule's ET monitoring is combined with soil sensing, weather data, and irrigation management in one platform. Enrichment found no independent public API, developer portal, SDK, or documented developer program for Tule Technologies.

providers.name: WeGrow asia CO., LTD.
providers.description: WeGrow asia CO., LTD. (威果) is a Taiwan-based agricultural technology company operating a franchise model for modern, technology-driven farming. It pairs 24-hour AI-assisted remote crop management with a transparent farmer profit-sharing model, specializing in high-value strawberries and cantaloupes while handling production, labor management, marketing, and logistics end to end ("you provide the land, we provide the labor and expertise"). WeGrow surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it publishes a bilingual (TW/EN) marketing website only and exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface — every probed developer and well-known path returned HTTP 404.

providers.name: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
providers.description: The National Institute of Food and Agriculture (NIFA) provides leadership and funding for programs that advance agriculture-related sciences. NIFA invests in and supports initiatives that ensure the long-term viability of agriculture, partnering with land-grant universities and the broader agricultural research community.

providers.name: Tidal Vision
providers.description: Tidal Vision Products, Inc. is a Bellingham, Washington biotechnology and specialty-chemicals manufacturer, and the only commercial-scale US producer of chitosan — a non-toxic, non-hazmat, biodegradable industrial biopolymer upcycled from crab and shrimp shell waste. Its zero-waste Chitofining process extracts, modifies and formulates chitosan chemistries that displace PFAS, halogenated chemicals, toxic antimicrobials and persistent plastics across three business lines: Tidal Clear water and wastewater treatment, Tidal Grow AgriScience crop and soil inputs, and Tidal-Tec Biomaterial Science performance materials. The company closed an oversubscribed $140M+ Series B in 2025 and acquired Clear Water Services. It is a materials-science manufacturer and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Alliance One International
providers.description: Alliance One International was a global leaf tobacco merchant that purchased, processed, and sold leaf tobacco to manufacturers of cigarettes and other consumer tobacco products. Founded in 2005 through the merger of Dimon Incorporated and Standard Commercial Corporation, Alliance One International became one of the world's two largest leaf tobacco dealers. The company sourced tobacco from major growing regions including the United States, Brazil, Zimbabwe, Malawi, Turkey, and other countries. In 2018, Alliance One International changed its name to Pyxus International, reflecting a broader diversification strategy beyond tobacco into hemp, cannabis, and e-liquids. As an agricultural commodity trading business, Alliance One International did not maintain a public developer API program.

providers.name: Cal-Maine Foods
providers.description: Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. is the largest producer and distributor of fresh shell eggs in the United States. The company sells most of its shell eggs to grocery store chains, club stores, foodservice distributors, and egg product consumers across the country and produces specialty eggs including organic, cage-free, free-range, and nutritionally enhanced varieties. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: Pattern Ag
providers.description: Pattern Ag was a predictive-agronomy company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Emeryville, California, that applied DNA sequencing and soil metagenomics to forecast agronomic outcomes twelve months ahead of a growing season. Its Complete Bio and Pattern 360 products profiled the soil microbiome to predict pest, pathogen and nutrient-deficiency pressure, informing crop-protection, seed-selection and fertility decisions for corn and soybean growers, and in 2023 the company announced what it described as the world's largest single-ecosystem metagenomics database. In August 2024 Pattern Ag merged with soil-sensing company EarthOptics; the combined business operates under the EarthOptics name and the Pattern Ag brand has been retired. As of this profile the pattern.ag website issues an HTTP 301 to www.earthoptics.com, every Pattern Ag deep link returns 404, and the Pattern Ag LinkedIn page redirects to an EarthOptics company page. Pattern Ag never published a public developer program, API documentation, SDKs or a machine-readable API contract under its own brand, and no Pattern Ag API surface survives. The successor company's private REST API is profiled separately at all/earth-optics.

providers.name: Titan Machinery
providers.description: Titan Machinery Inc. owns and operates one of the largest networks of full-service agricultural and construction equipment dealer stores in North America and Europe. The company sells, services, and rents new and used Case IH, New Holland, Case Construction, and other branded equipment, along with parts and precision farming technology. Titan Machinery serves farmers, ranchers, and construction contractors across multiple states and countries.

providers.name: Wikifarmer
providers.description: Wikifarmer is a global agricultural platform that connects producers with buyers through a B2B marketplace for agricultural products and educates farmers through expert-reviewed content. It provides practical agricultural knowledge, market access, and price insights for farmers, agribusinesses, traders, and food companies worldwide, with a multilingual educational library covering crop cultivation, livestock, sustainability, soil management, irrigation, pest control, and post-harvest handling, alongside a global marketplace connecting suppliers and buyers and a price-insights service for agricultural commodities.

providers.name: Farm Credit Administration
providers.description: The Farm Credit Administration (FCA) is an independent federal agency responsible for regulating and supervising the Farm Credit System, a nationwide network of cooperatively owned institutions that provide credit and financial services to farmers, ranchers, and other agricultural borrowers. The FCA ensures that the Farm Credit System operates in a safe and sound manner and provides fair and competitive services. FCA does not publish a public REST API; however, the FCS Data Portal and downloadable Call Reports provide programmatic access to financial data on Farm Credit System institutions.

providers.name: Lansing Trade Group
providers.description: Lansing Trade Group was an international merchandiser, marketer, and logistics company specializing in bulk commodities including grains, biofuels, and energy products. In 2022, The Andersons completed the acquisition of Lansing Trade Group; its commodities business now operates as part of The Andersons' Trade Group.

providers.name: InRisk
providers.description: InRisk Labs is a climate insurtech company building parametric insurance products for climate and disaster risk financing. Its platform pairs an AI-driven pricing engine, real-time geospatial and weather monitoring, and blockchain smart contracts to deliver rapid, data-triggered payouts across 15+ parametric products spanning agriculture (crop, livestock, agri-input), renewable energy (solar, wind), logistics, tourism, energy demand, infrastructure protection, and wage and business-interruption cover. Risk models incorporate global climate drivers such as ENSO and IOD and range from India to global coverage. InRisk exposes an "API on-demand" so insurance partners can integrate customized products, dynamic pricing, and real-time analytics into their own infrastructure. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: Green Plains
providers.description: Green Plains is a vertically integrated ethanol producer that operates ethanol plants, grain handling and storage facilities, and a cattle-feeding operation. No public APIs are documented.

providers.name: Stable
providers.description: Stable is an insurtech company that provides price risk management and price insurance for agricultural and food commodities, helping farmers, food producers, buyers, and businesses hedge against the volatility of commodity prices. Backed by Anthemis and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub, Stable operates a price-stabilization platform rather than a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Biophero
providers.description: BioPhero is a Danish agricultural biotechnology company that engineers microbes to produce synthetic insect pheromones via microbial fermentation, providing low-cost, bio-based pest control that disrupts insect mating cycles on major row crops without toxic insecticides. Founded as a spin-out from the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), BioPhero raised a DCVC Bio-led Series A (with FMC Ventures, Syngenta Group Ventures, and Novo Holdings) and was subsequently acquired by FMC Corporation. The company is a DCVC portfolio holding surfaced in the API Evangelist network; it operates as a research and product organization in synthetic biology and crop protection and publishes no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or agent-facing surface.

providers.name: SunFarmer
providers.description: SunFarmer is a solar energy company operating primarily in Nepal that designs, installs, finances, and services solar power systems for health facilities, schools, agriculture, and businesses. Its mission is to make reliable solar energy affordable across underserved communities, powering water pumping, clinics, and irrigation. SunFarmer reports over 3.2 million cubic meters of water pumped, 1.5+ million units of clean electricity generated, and nearly 1.8 million kilograms of CO2 offset. It offers a "Get Solar" customer path and a "Give Solar" donation program. It is a direct-to-customer solar services and social-impact provider with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Forest Service
providers.description: The Forest Service is an agency within the U.S. Department of Agriculture that is responsible for managing the nation's forests and grasslands.
